paragraphs: Yehotzadak. R' Yehoshua ben Yehotzadak; Pesachim 95b.[^1]

notes.text: [The passage at Pesachim 95b](https://www.sefaria.org/Pesachim.95b.2) has Rabbi Yochanan citing Rabbi Shimon ben Yehotzadak. Hyman gives Yehoshua. [Heilprin’s Yehotzadak entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1754&lang=en) lists Yishmael and Shimon, and [his notice on Shimon](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3455&lang=en) cites this passage.
